This '''unidentified Imperial commander''' served as the immediate successor of the [[Unidentified Imperial admiral (Griff's successor)|admiral]] in command of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during its maiden voyage. After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed the admiral for doubting him, this [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] assumed command.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Strangely, this character bears an almost identical resemblance to the dead Imperial admiral whom he replaces to take command of the ''Executor'', although the two should not be confused with one another.

Despite this article's reference to this character as a "commander," this should not be confused with the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. The comic ''[[Race for Survival]]'' does not identify this Imperial officer as holding any specific rank.
